testcase.name: Scenario: Keep staged command order when clicking the target Name header: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:726:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Keep staged command order when clicking the target Name header ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog has an initially empty Part Tools custom panel ✔ And the user has staged "3D Annotations" followed by "2D Sketches" ✔ When the user clicks the custom panel list Name header twice ✔ Then the custom panel list remains in this order: | 3D Annotations | | 2D Sketches | ✔ And the target indicates a pending change ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel is displayed on the Tools ribbon
